native_hydrogen_premise.keyword_source_note: MAKE HYDR All and MAKE HOUT No are native REFMAC5 defaults, not keywords newly passed by scripts/onesar_refmac.py.
native_hydrogen_premise.internal_scattering_behavior: Under default MAKE HYDR All, REFMAC restores hydrogens in their riding positions and uses them for geometry and structure-factor calculations (and the gradient and second-derivative matrix of the geometry residual).
native_hydrogen_premise.output_coordinate_behavior: Under default MAKE HOUT No, REFMAC does not write generated riding hydrogens to the output coordinate file (XYZOUT).
native_hydrogen_premise.pdb_atom_audit_boundary: An output PDB (XYZOUT) atom audit inspects written coordinate records only and cannot establish identical internal scattering populations across tools (such as PHENIX versus REFMAC5).
native_hydrogen_premise.downstream_reporting_requirement: Later result slides and reports must disclose this native REFMAC hydrogen treatment (MAKE HYDR All / MAKE HOUT No) and explicitly distinguish written output coordinates from internal structure-factor scattering populations.

excerpts.lines_90_98_make_hydr:
HYDR [ Yes | No | All ] (Default HYDRogens All)
How to deal with the hydrogen atoms.
Y - if hydrogens are present in the input file, use them,
N - ignore hydrogens even if they are present in the input coordinate file,
A - add all hydrogens in their riding positions and use them for geometry and structure factor calculations. They also contribute to the gradient and second derivative matrix of geometry residual.
For low resolution and early stages it is better to use MAKE HYDR N, i.e. do not use hydrogens even if they are present in the input file.
excerpts.lines_100_103_make_hout:
HOUT [ Yes | No ] (Default HOUT N)
Whether to write hydrogens to the output coordinate file or not.
Y - write hydrogens to the output file,
N - do not write hydrogens to the output file.
